name: ricochet
description: Deploy and run Shiny apps, APIs, Quarto reports, notebooks, and R, Python, and Julia scripts on Ricochet.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy R, Python, and Julia work
interface.longDescription: Deploy Shiny apps, Plumber and FastAPI services, Quarto reports, Jupyter notebooks, and R, Python, and Julia scripts to Ricochet. Schedule tasks, read the signed-in user, set CPU and memory, scale apps, call the REST API, and fix failed deployments.
